description: This file defines middleware functions for security and request handling in an Express.js application, including CORS configuration, Helmet security headers, and rate limiting. It also exports these middleware functions for use in the server setup.

methods.name: toOriginMaybe
methods.description: Normalizes a URL-like string to an origin (scheme://host[:port]) or returns null if invalid.

methods.name: corsMiddleware
methods.description: Builds and returns an Express middleware for handling CORS with a dynamically computed whitelist based on environment variables.

methods.name: helmetMiddleware
methods.description: Builds and returns an Express middleware for setting security headers with relaxed Content Security Policy.

methods.name: rateLimiter
methods.description: Builds and returns an Express middleware for rate limiting requests, configurable via environment variables.
